findings.file: .github/workflows/ci.yml:158,162,192,196,312,316 (and the comment at :95, the names at :192/:312, and the fixture in tools/gate-parity.py ri2 ~:358-359)
findings.issue: The Windows pin is `windows-2025-vs2026`. Per the orchestrator-verified fact (GitHub-hosted runners label tables, actions/runner-images README, 2026-05-14 changelog) that label is documented as meant for testing only, is redundant because windows-2025 itself moved to VS 2026, and is ABSENT from the private-repository label table; `windows-2025` is the stable label. The executor took the name from the `Image:` line of the run log and states in outcome.technical that it 'was not verified' as a runs-on label. A pin to a testing-only label is the same fragility the task removes: an unsupported label can queue forever or be retired, and it hits every Windows cell (selftests, e2e, resample). The Linux pin ubuntu-24.04 is valid.
findings.resolution: Pin `windows-2025` everywhere: the matrix `os` axis (:158), the `exclude` row (:162), the e2e and resample `runs-on` (:196, :316) and their display names (:192, :312), the header comment (:95). Update the ri2 fixture, which uses `windows-2025-vs2026` as the example of an explicit image, to `windows-2025`. ri1's wording already names windows-2025.

findings.issue: The pin changes the check names the workflow reports: the selftests cells (`selftests (${{ matrix.os }}, ...)` now print ubuntu-24.04 / the Windows label), `e2e (...)`, `lint + e2e (ubuntu-24.04)` and `resample (...)`. A branch-protection required-check entry for the old names, which lives in repository settings outside the tree, would never report. The executor checked tools/ci-verified.py (prefix `resample (`) but not the remote required-checks list. Putting the image name into a display name also means the next image move renames the check again.
findings.resolution: State in the hand-off that the owner must update the repository's required-check list. Optionally drop the image name from the e2e, lint and resample names so a future image bump does not rename the check.

findings.issue: `_matrix_key_values` reads only an inline `key: [a, b]` or scalar. A block-sequence axis (`os:` with `- ubuntu-latest` on following lines) yields no value from the axis. If an `include` or `exclude` row also names `os`, the check sees only those rows and passes a floating axis value without comment. If the key is listed nowhere, it is reported, so only the mixed shape is silent. ci.yml does not use the shape today.
findings.resolution: Treat an empty `rest` after `key:` as a block sequence and collect the following `- value` lines at deeper indent, or report the job as unreadable when a matrix key line has no inline value. Add a case beside ri4.

intent.note: Clause (a): "assert on return_trap_probe's reason (the probe ran and the shell rejected the trap) the way vsh11/vsh14 do, and skip with a stated reason when dash is absent". The diff at tools/gate-parity.py ~:2990-2997 computes `_rt_dash_probe = return_trap_probe(_rt_dash)` and asserts `_rt_dash_probe == (False, None)`, so an unstartable dash (False, 'OSError ...') no longer satisfies it, and the skip branch for an absent dash is kept. Clause (b): "say only that it raises an OSError". The comment now reads 'raises an OSError on posix, and starting an extensionless path raises an OSError on Windows too ... Which error it is differs and the case does not read it', which makes no WinError claim. Both match. The description handed opens with 'Also, from the BF4.1 review', so its leading clause was not handed; the runner-pin work was judged against desiredOutcome ('every job pins its runner image') and the bug text at audit-plan.json:10766. Every runs-on and matrix os value (axis, exclude row) is explicit, and floating_runners() reports the plain label, `${{ matrix.K }}` over axes/include/exclude rows, a missing runs-on, a foreign expression, an unlisted key and a workflow with no jobs, each reported rather than passed. Only a block-sequence axis falls through (finding 3). The claim describes the diff, with one gap: the executor's own outcome says the Windows label was 'not verified' as a runs-on label, and it is the testing-only one (finding 1). The display-name renames are mentioned in the claim.

intent.inheritedTestsBasis: tests.gate lists `selftests` -> `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py`, which runs the whole project's selftests with no path scope, plus validate, plugin-validate, report, lint, shots and interactive.
